items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter states its own delivery fiction: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.' Versandtag = Samstag, 21.11.2026. Counting 4 days from 21.11.: 22.11 (Sun)=1, 23.11 (Mon)=2, 24.11 (Tue)=3, 25.11 (Wed)=4 -> Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) = 25.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §84 SGG in conjunction with §26 SGB X / §§187, 188 BGB: the day of notification (25.11.2026) is not counted (§187 Abs. 1 BGB), the period begins the next day and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, with the expiry of the day of the last month that corresponds by its number to the day of the triggering event, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is a Friday and 1. Weihnachtsfeiertag (public holiday in NW); 26.12.2026 (Saturday) is also 2. Weihnachtsfeiertag/weekend; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB the period is extended to the next working day, which is Monday, 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter's self-declared delivery fiction ('gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben') deviates from the standard statutory three-day rule under §37 Abs. 2 SGB X; the deadline above was computed using the letter's own four-day rule, but if the standard three-day rule actually applies the deadline could be one day earlier - verify with the issuing office if in doubt.

The letter is dated Wednesday 18.11.2026 but states it was dispatched on Saturday 21.11.2026 (a non-working day for postal/administrative dispatch); this unusual dispatch-day claim is worth double-checking against the envelope postmark if available.
